text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Raised in poverty, but giving her all for 
her family: the pint-sized Naniwa girl, 
Tamamo Cross. Her challenge in the Twinkle 
Series begins now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First, she takes on a mock race, but her 
prized closing kick, the "White 
Lightning," can't break through the pack 
of larger-bodied Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek, as affectionate as a mother, 
dotes on her close friend Tamamo Cross 
after her defeat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, shouting, "Don't treat me like a 
kid!" she gallantly dashed off to rescue 
her family from poverty.
